sentences.text:
Author: Jay Sengupta
Bench: Jay Sengupta
A 74 April 7, 2025 Ct. 28 Sg Crr 1528 of 2025 Cran 1 of 2025

In the matter of:
Sk. Sayed Ali @ Saheb and others ... petitioners Mr. Niladri Sekhar Ghosh Ms. Laboni Sikder Mr. Souvik Dey ...for the petitioners Mr. Debarshi Brahma Mr. Subarna Bank ... for the opposite party no.2.
Learned counsels for the petitioner and the opposite party No.2 submit that the disputes between the private parties have been settled.

Accordingly, charge-sheet filed on 29.11.2022 under Section 498A/406/323/325/307 IPC may be quashed.
Let the petitioners serve copy of the revisional application upon the State through the learned Public Prosecutor within a week from this date and affidavit of service shall be filed on the next date.
List this matter under the heading "Motion" after two weeks.
State shall produce the case diary on the next date.

( Jay Sengupta, J. )
